abilities.critical_failure: The creature is sickened 2 by the pain caused by contact with the nettles and is also clumsy 1 for 24 hours from the lingering pain.
abilities.critical_success: The creature avoids being stung by the plant's nettles.
abilities.effect: The triggering creature must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude save if they're walking through the square or a DC 20 Fortitude save if they touched the nettles.
abilities.failure: The creature is sickened 1 by the pain caused by contact with the nettles and is also clumsy 1 for 8 hours from the lingering pain.
abilities.name: Sting
abilities.success: The creature is sickened 1 by the pain caused by brief contact with the nettles.

traits.name: Poison
traits.text: An effect with this trait delivers a poison or deals poison damage. An item with this trait is poisonous and might cause an affliction.

abilities.trigger: A creature touches the stinging nettles or moves through a square containing stinging nettles

hazard.description: This bright green plant has long triangular leaves covered with fine hair-like stingers.
hazard.disable: DC 17 Survival to carefully navigate the plant and pull aside or cut away the nettles
hazard.name: Stinging Nettles

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Plant
traits.text: Vegetable creatures have the plant trait. They are distinct from normal plants. Magical effects with this trait manipulate or conjure plants or plant matter in some way. Effects that manipulate plants have no effect in an area with no plants.
